period: c.1934 North Atlantic liner, first-class writing room

nouns.materials: pale bird's-eye maple veneer top and modesty panel, macassar ebony legs, chrome ferrules
nouns.subject: A moderne writing desk: a rectangular top with a shallow pen tray at the back, a single central drawer with a chrome bar pull, four slender tapering legs.
nouns.avoid: computer, lamp on the desk, papers,

nouns.materials: deep-blue wool upholstery, pale maple veneer plinth, macassar feet
nouns.subject: A low moderne club armchair: a rounded barrel back flowing into padded arms, a loose seat cushion, a shallow veneered plinth base.

nouns.materials: pale maple veneer top, macassar ebony column and base, chrome ring
nouns.subject: A small round side table: a circular veneered top on a single tapered column rising from a round stepped base, with a thin chrome ring where column meets top.

nouns.materials: chrome stem, macassar ebony base, cream parchment drum shade
nouns.subject: A slender moderne floor lamp: a round stepped ebony base, a polished chrome stem, a plain cream drum shade at the top, switched off.

nouns.materials: pale maple veneer carcass, macassar ebony plinth, chrome edge strip
nouns.subject: A low open bookcase with two shelves, veneered carcass with rounded vertical ends, a dark plinth, empty shelves.

nouns.materials: macassar ebony veneer with a chrome rim
nouns.subject: A tapered cylindrical wastepaper basket, veneered, with a polished chrome rim at the top, empty.

nouns.materials: pale maple veneer case, chrome bezel, cream dial
nouns.subject: A small moderne mantel clock: a stepped veneered case, a round chrome bezel, a plain cream dial with slim hands and no numerals.

nouns.materials: chrome stem and hooks, macassar ebony base
nouns.subject: A moderne coat stand: a round stepped ebony base, a polished chrome column, six curved chrome hooks near the top, nothing hanging on it.
